action_description: Submit fresh/renewal form on ePASS portal; upload MeeSeva certificates and allotment orders
Perform biometric fingerprint authentication linked with Aadhaar
Verify bonafide status, regular attendance (min 75%), certificates; upload hard copies with barcode
Submit verified barcode application bundles and student hard copies to DSCDO/DWO office
Cross-verify data against MeeSeva, SSC, and Inter boards; issue sanction orders
Audit budget availability, pass electronic bills, and push payment via e-Kuber / DBT
Disburse RTF direct to college bank account and MTF to student's personal account
Submit official Utilization Certificates (UC) to DSCDO/DWO
